name: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI)
description:
Detects Medicare Beneficiary Identifiers (MBI) used since April 2018. Format: 1 character + AC-HJKMNP-RT-Y + AC-HJKMNP-RT-Y0-9 + digit + AC-HJKMNP-RT-Y + AC-HJKMNP-RT-Y0-9 + digit + 2 letters + 2 digits (e.g., 1AB2C3D4EF56). Excludes easily confused characters (S, L, O, I, B, Z).

Official name: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier
PHI category: Health Plan Beneficiary Number
HIPAA category: Health plan beneficiary numbers
Format: New format since April 2018, replaces HICN

effect.message: Medicare beneficiary ID tokenized for de-identification
